verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke yena Juda de vrẹn nẹ asan rẹ imoni rọye epha, ọ da vwẹriẹ asan rẹ ohwo rẹ Adulam ọvo, re se odẹ rọye Hirah.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke yena juda de vren ne asan re imoni roye epha o da vwerie asan re ohwo re adulam ovo re se ode roye hirah

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Juda da mrẹ ọmọtẹ rẹ ohwo ri Kenan ọvo re se odẹ rọye Shua, ọ da rọvwọ ọ vọye da mroma,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin juda da mre omote re ohwo ri kenan ovo re se ode roye shua o da rovwo o voye da mroma

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da mrevun o de vwiẹ ọmọshare, o de se odẹ rọye Ẹr.
verses.text_romanized: o da mrevun o de vwie omoshare o de se ode roye er

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da rhoma mrevun o de vwiẹ ọshare ọfa, o de se odẹ rọye Ọnan.
verses.text_romanized: o da rhoma mrevun o de vwie oshare ofa o de se ode roye onan

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da rhoma vwiẹ ọshare ọfa, o de se odẹ rọye Shelah. Chezib ọ epha ọke ro vwo vwiẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da rhoma vwie oshare ofa o de se ode roye shelah chezib o epha oke ro vwo vwie

verses.text_urhobo: Juda da reyọ aye vwọ kẹ Ẹr rẹ ọwanra rọye re se Tamar.
verses.text_romanized: juda da reyo aye vwo ke er re owanra roye re se tamar

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ẹr rẹ ọwanra ri Juda, da dia ohwo umwemwu vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo; Ọrovwohwo de hwe.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo er re owanra ri juda da dia ohwo umwemwu vwe obaro re orovwohwo orovwohwo de hwe

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Juda da ta kẹ Ọnan, Bru aye rẹ oniọvo wẹ na ra, ru wo ru obo re ruẹ ke aye re oniọvo kẹ, rere wo vwiẹ ọmọ kẹ oniọvo wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin juda da ta ke onan bru aye re oniovo we na ra ru wo ru obo re rue ke aye re oniovo ke rere wo vwie omo ke oniovo wen

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọnan riẹnre nẹ ọmọ na cha dia ọrọye-e; kọye ro vwo nene aye rẹ oniọvo rọye na mroma re, o de hwẹ ameoma na kufia rere aye re oniọvo rọye na vwo je vwiẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo onan rienre ne omo na cha dia oroye e koye ro vwo nene aye re oniovo roye na mroma re o de hwe ameoma na kufia rere aye re oniovo roye na vwo je vwie

verses.text_urhobo: Obo ro ruru na da bra vwẹ obaro rẹ Ọrovwohwo, Etiyin ọ da je teyọ hwe.
verses.text_romanized: obo ro ruru na da bra vwe obaro re orovwohwo etiyin o da je teyo hwe

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Juda da ta kẹ aye re ọmọ rọye na Tamar ne, Gba dia ayeuku vwẹ uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ wẹn bẹsiẹ ri Shelah rẹ ọmọ mẹ vwọ ghwanre - kidie oshọ muro nẹ o de rhe ghwu ọboba kiri iniọvo rọye. Kọye Tamar da ra dia uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin juda da ta ke aye re omo roye na tamar ne gba dia ayeuku vwe uwevwi re ose wen besie ri shelah re omo me vwo ghwanre kidie osho muro ne o de rhe ghwu oboba kiri iniovo roye koye tamar da ra dia uwevwi re ose roye

verses.text_urhobo: Emerha aye ri Juda, rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Shua, de ghwu, ọke rẹ ẹro vwọ hiẹ Juda nure, o de kpo Timnah ra mrẹ ihwo re bọrọ igodẹ rọye, te ọye te ugbeyan rọye Hirah rẹ ohwo rẹ Adulam.
verses.text_romanized: emerha aye ri juda re omote ri shua de ghwu oke re ero vwo hie juda nure o de kpo timnah ra mre ihwo re boro igode roye te oye te ugbeyan roye hirah re ohwo re adulam

verses.text_urhobo: Ra vwọ ta ki Tamar nẹ, Ọsọrọvwe wẹn yanran kpo Timnah ra bọrọ igodẹ,
verses.text_romanized: ra vwo ta ki tamar ne osorovwe wen yanran kpo timnah ra boro igode

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da ghwiẹ iwun rẹ uvweri rọye nu, ọ da vwẹ oga vwo rhurhu, ọ da vwẹ emwa kroma, o de tidia unu rẹ egodo rọ Enaim rọ idjerhe ra wan kpo Timnah, kidie ọ mrẹre nẹ Shelah ghwaire, yẹ a je vwẹ ọye kẹ vwọ rọvwọ-ọ.
verses.text_romanized: o da ghwie iwun re uvweri roye nu o da vwe oga vwo rhurhu o da vwe emwa kroma o de tidia unu re egodo ro enaim ro idjerhe ra wan kpo timnah kidie o mrere ne shelah ghwaire ye a je vwe oye ke vwo rovwo o

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Juda vwọ mrẹ o de vwo roro igberadja, kidie ọ vwẹ oga rhurhu opharo.
verses.text_romanized: oke ri juda vwo mre o de vwo roro igberadja kidie o vwe oga rhurhu opharo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da yanran bro kpo abọ rivẹ rẹ idjerhe na, ọ da ta kẹ, Yanrhe re Me vowẹ ruemu, kidie ọ rha riẹn nẹ aye rẹ ọmọ rọye-e. Ọ da ta, kidie wọ vwọ kẹ vwẹ, ri wo ki nene uvwe ruemu?
verses.text_romanized: o da yanran bro kpo abo rive re idjerhe na o da ta ke yanrhe re me vowe ruemu kidie o rha rien ne aye re omo roye e o da ta kidie wo vwo ke vwe ri wo ki nene uvwe ruemu

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da kpahe, Mi mu ẹmẹvwe nẹ usun rẹ uchuru mẹ na rhe we. Ọ da ta, Ku wọ vwẹ emu viẹnwa kẹ vwẹ, bẹsiẹ wo vwo muo rhe?
verses.text_romanized: o da kpahe mi mu emevwe ne usun re uchuru me na rhe we o da ta ku wo vwe emu vienwa ke vwe besie wo vwo muo rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta, Ki didi emu mi vwo viẹnwa kẹ wẹ? Ọ da kpahe, Isa wẹn kugbe eme wẹn, kugbe ọkpọ wẹn ro rhe we obọ na. Etiyin ọ da vwẹ ayen kẹ, ọ vọye da mroma, ọ da ghwa mrevun.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ki didi emu mi vwo vienwa ke we o da kpahe isa wen kugbe eme wen kugbe okpo wen ro rhe we obo na etiyin o da vwe ayen ke o voye da mroma o da ghwa mrevun

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin o vrẹnri ọ da yanran, ọ ghwiẹ oga na nu o de ku iwun rẹ uvweri rọye phihọ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin o vrenri o da yanran o ghwie oga na nu o de ku iwun re uvweri roye phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Juda vwọ reyọ ẹmẹvwe na vwo rhe ugbeyan rọye rẹ ohwo rẹ Adulam na, rere ọ reyọ ekuakua ro vwo viẹnwa na mie aye na, o gbe mrẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ri juda vwo reyo emevwe na vwo rhe ugbeyan roye re ohwo re adulam na rere o reyo ekuakua ro vwo vienwa na mie aye na o gbe mre e

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da nọ ihwo rẹ asan na nẹ, Kẹ igberadja rọ Enaim na rhọ rọ oma rẹ idjerhe na? Ayen da tanẹ, Igberadja ọvuọvo etinẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da no ihwo re asan na ne ke igberadja ro enaim na rho ro oma re idjerhe na ayen da tane igberadja ovuovo etine e

verses.text_urhobo: O de rhivwi bru Juda, ọ da ta, Me mrẹrẹ-ẹ, ihwo rẹ asan na je tanẹ, Igberadja ọvuọvo etinẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o de rhivwi bru juda o da ta me mrere e ihwo re asan na je tane igberadja ovuovo etine e

verses.text_urhobo: Juda da kpahe, E gbe jọ yọnrọn ekuakua na kẹ oma rọye, a da rha hwẹ avwanre, wọ mrẹre, Me vwẹ ẹmẹvwe na rhe, yu wọ mrẹrẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: juda da kpahe e gbe jo yonron ekuakua na ke oma roye a da rha hwe avwanre wo mrere me vwe emevwe na rhe yu wo mrere e

verses.text_urhobo: Kirẹ emeranvwe erha ka rhe ta ki Juda nẹ, Tamar rẹ aye rẹ ọmọ wẹn gbe igberadja; kidie ọ wan igberadja na mrevun Juda da ta, Reyọ rhe rere a torhẹ hwe.
verses.text_romanized: kire emeranvwe erha ka rhe ta ki juda ne tamar re aye re omo wen gbe igberadja kidie o wan igberadja na mrevun juda da ta reyo rhe rere a torhe hwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ra vwọ reyọ cha re, o de ji ohwo ra vuẹ ọsorọvwe rọye nẹ, Ohwo ro vwo ekuakua nana, ọye re kẹ vwẹ evun na. Ọ da ta, Vughe te, Me rẹ wẹ, ono ri vwo enana isa na, eme na kugbe ọkpọ na.
verses.text_romanized: ra vwo reyo cha re o de ji ohwo ra vue osorovwe roye ne ohwo ro vwo ekuakua nana oye re ke vwe evun na o da ta vughe te me re we ono ri vwo enana isa na eme na kugbe okpo na

verses.text_urhobo: Juda de vughe ayen ọ da ta, Ọ dia ọvwata nọ vwẹ, kidie ọ rha guakẹ vwẹ vwọ kẹ Shelaha-a. O vọye gbe mroma ọfa-a.
verses.text_romanized: juda de vughe ayen o da ta o dia ovwata no vwe kidie o rha guake vwe vwo ke shelaha a o voye gbe mroma ofa a

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ uvwiẹ rọye rhi vwo te, agbava kọye evun rọye.
verses.text_romanized: oke re uvwie roye rhi vwo te agbava koye evun roye

verses.text_urhobo: Rọ vwọ chuẹ uvwiẹ re, ọvo da vwẹ obọ rhe, orhere na de churu isene muo obọ, tanẹ, Ona re ka rhe.
verses.text_romanized: ro vwo chue uvwie re ovo da vwe obo rhe orhere na de churu isene muo obo tane ona re ka rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ro rhe vwo si obọ reyọ, nighere oniọvo rọye de ghwe ri shotọ; ọ da ta, Didi uphrophro wọ rha rharhe kẹ oma wẹn, fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e de se odẹ rọye Pẹrẹz.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ro rhe vwo si obo reyo nighere oniovo roye de ghwe ri shoto o da ta didi uphrophro wo rha rharhe ke oma wen fiki re otioye na e de se ode roye perez

verses.text_urhobo: Emerha oniọvo rọye de rhi shotọ vẹ isene re churu muo obọ e de rhe se odẹ rọye Zerah.
verses.text_romanized: emerha oniovo roye de rhi shoto ve isene re churu muo obo e de rhe se ode roye zerah
